title: FB-029 isolate Audit and Rerun launch button gates
summary: Fix FR-030 by preventing Audit and CSV Rerun launch buttons from reusing Pipeline Processor start-decision gating.
reason: Worker findings W08-001/W08-004 showed Audit and CSV Rerun controls built their own request for backend preflight matching but then evaluated blocked readiness through collectPipelineStartRequest().
behavior_before: Audit and CSV Rerun button disabled state could be controlled by stale or unrelated Pipeline Processor form state after their own backend preflight target was ready.
behavior_after: Audit and CSV Rerun buttons return their own backend-preflight target gate; Pipeline Start and Pending Drain continue to use pipeline start-decision gating.
